content: supabase-js does not group multiple sequential .from() calls into one transaction; each is an independent HTTP request to PostgREST. To get atomicity across multiple table deletes, wrap the SQL in a single Postgres function and call it via supabase.rpc('fn_name', params) — PostgREST automatically wraps the whole RPC call in one transaction. auth.admin.deleteUser() is a separate GoTrue Admin HTTP API call and cannot participate in that same SQL transaction, so it must run as a subsequent step after the RPC commits.
